disposition: retain with authority corrections; candidate only

execution.alternatives: bounded independent inspection; worktrees do not isolate live HOME

changes.summary: Separate review, edit, capture, apply and publication authority; correct hook semantics; preserve targeted capture, template and age expertise.

questions.question: Should source edits imply apply authority?
questions.recommendation: Keep source edit and live apply separately authorized.
questions.rationale: Apply may trigger hooks and deploy unrelated pending changes.

validation: Static walkthroughs of review-only, candidate-only, template edit, live capture and dirty-tree publication; inspected wrapper capture and git add -A behavior.
limitations: No live harness or wrapper workflow execution.
